Blah. Meh.
Sep 2014 • Couples
I really don't like leaving negative reviews, but the only redeeming feature of Duck Deli was the duck salad. Basically because it was almost the only thing left on the menu when we arrived for dinner at 7.30pm. I'd read a few good reviews online and it was near our hotel so I was feeling positive, but should have run for the door when seeing that the place was empty, playing western pop music and the staff barely understood a word I was saying. When we sat down the staff gave us a menu and stood next to us until we'd made a choice. 

We tried to order the curry, but alas - none left. Also not much else available, we settled for the duck salad and some other kind of duck/rice soup combination. The duck salad was enjoyable but the other dish was horrendous. I feel like this place *could* be great -- the decor was nice and it has lots of opportunity to be decent but really needs improvements in service and food availability -- how are you meant to get people in the door if no food is available?

AVOID!!
